requirements.description: Notices are listed newest first; unread notices are visually distinct; the unread count is shown.
Loading, empty and error are distinct states; the error state offers retry and the empty state offers refresh.
Notice text is displayed as text — markup in a title is never interpreted.

items.description: newest-first, stable, non-mutating sort; correct unread count
ready state renders rows newest first with unread markers and the count badge
every user-generated field that reaches HTML goes through the single escaping function
sorting must not reorder the caller's array in place (a shared-state bug the list would otherwise hide)
loading, empty and error are distinct, each with its own message and action

items.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="never renders as an empty list" test/render.test.js
items.description: RL-2: a failed load never shows the empty-list sentence
RL-1: markup in a title is rendered as text
list density and hierarchy match REF-1: one row per notice, bold title + dot when unread, muted right-aligned time, 12px rhythm, no clipping
ANTI-1: no raw colors or card shadows in the component styles (tokens only)
sensor ui dimension stays above its threshold on the feature source
empty and error states each give one sentence and exactly one obvious next action, per REF-2
actions are focusable type=button elements (keyboard reachable, never submit a form)
loading state is announced to assistive tech

qualityWaivers.reason: Escaping has no visual or interaction surface of its own; it is fully decided by the RB-5 pitfall command.

na.crossFeature: read-only list; no other feature reads or writes notices in this scope
na.persistence: non-goal: read state is not stored by this feature
